packageRules.description: Undo :separatePatchReleases for managers whose updates share a lock file. It splits minor and patch into separate lookup buckets, which runs before the update type is known, so this rule must not match on update type. Without it a group splits into <group> and patch-<group> branches.

Every Go module update edits go.mod and go.sum, so separate PRs conflict as soon as one merges. Non-major updates land as one PR; majors stay separate. The go toolchain (golang-version datasource) keeps its own PR. The table adds the Update column, which mergeConfidence:age-confidence-badges drops for go and npm, so each row shows whether it is a patch or a minor.
Every crate update edits Cargo.lock, so separate PRs conflict as soon as one merges. Non-major updates land as one PR; majors stay separate.

Every npm package update edits the package.json and lock file of its project, so separate PRs conflict as soon as one merges. Non-major updates land as one PR; majors stay separate. The table adds the Update column, which mergeConfidence:age-confidence-badges drops for go and npm, so each row shows whether it is a patch or a minor.
